messages.selectSource: Select a card from your nertz pile, waste, or tableau.
messages.selectTarget: Pick a foundation or tableau column to move to.

settings.title: Settings
settings.cpuSpeedHelp: Adjust how often the CPUs play a card. Faster ticks make the race harder (Slow = 1200ms / Normal = 700ms / Fast = 400ms).

tutorial.intro: Nertz is a real-time competitive solitaire where several players race in parallel.
tutorial.nertzPile: This is your Nertz pile — empty it first to win the round.
tutorial.tableau: The tableau builds down in alternating colors, like Klondike.
tutorial.foundations: The central foundations are shared. Start with an Ace and build up by suit.
tutorial.stock: Draw from the stock to pull more cards through your waste.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset to start a new game.
